prompt: Announce the 6-and-under tee-ball season opener like it's a pay-per-view main event.
response:
*(Microphone feedback whines, then a booming, echoing voice fills the stadium)*

**"LADIES AND GENTLEMEN!** 

Broadcasting LIVE on closed-circuit television from the sun-drenched, freshly raked dirt of Field Number Four behind the elementary school… we welcome you to the absolute pinnacle of early-childhood athletic combat! 

This is the event you’ve been waiting for! The clash on the clay! The rumble in the rec league! Tonight, we settle the score for the Undisputed, Unified, 6-and-Under Snack Bracket Championship of the WOOOOOOORLD!

*(Crowd noise swells, AC/DC's "Thunderstruck" plays faintly in the background)*

Here is the tale of the tape! 

In the first base dugout… wearing the oversized neon green jerseys that go past their knees… weighing in at a combined 450 pounds of pure, unbridled, sugary hyperactivity… they are fueled by 100% pure apple juice and an absolute refusal to adhere to bedtime! Undefeated against their own velcro shoes… Give it up for the terrifying, the titanic, The Southside GREEN DESTROYEEEEERS!

*(Airhorns blast over a smattering of clapping parents)*

And in the third base dugout… the challengers! Forged in the fires of afternoon naptime! Clad in the royal blue caps that keep falling over their eyes! This fearsome squad boasts a devastating lineup where at least three players know which direction first base is! They are the masters of the dirt-clod throw! The sultans of the Capri Sun! The Elm Street BLUE JAAAAAAAYS!

*(More airhorns, a baby cries in the distance)*

The rules of this contest are sanctioned by the Parks and Recreation Commission! Three innings of merciless, tee-striking violence! There will be no lead-offs! There will be no stealing! And there will be absolutely NO crying when you accidentally swing and hit the rubber tube instead of the ball! 

The umpires for tonight’s bout are two bored high school sophomores looking for community service hours! We ask that you protect yourself at all times, especially from bats being thrown wildly toward the on-deck circle!

So lock the gates! Cut the crusts off the PB&Js! And brace yourselves for the most chaotic forty-five minutes in sports entertainment! 

***LEEEEEET’S GET READY TO TOOOOOOODDDDDDDDLLLLLLLLE!***"
